context_requirements: Expression of at least one BCL2-family anti-apoptotic protein (BCL2, BCL2L1/BCL-XL, BCL2L2/BCL-W, or MCL1) at levels sufficient for survival dependence
Intact mitochondrial apoptosis machinery (BAX/BAK, caspase-9, APAF1)
Low or absent buffering by other anti-apoptotic family members
Cellular stress or oncogenic driver that creates a survival dependency on the targeted anti-apoptotic protein
falsifiers: No decrease in viability or increase in apoptosis markers (e.g., CASP3/7 cleavage, Annexin V) in any of the nine lines at 24 h
No transcriptional changes in BCL2-family or apoptosis-related landmark genes at either 6 h or 24 h
Uniform strong upregulation of anti-apoptotic genes (BCL2, BCL2L1, MCL1) without any pro-apoptotic or stress response
Lack of any dose-dependent or time-dependent transcriptional signature across the panel

evidence.supports: BCL-inhibitor BIM is a downstream effector of TAp63-mediated apoptosis, linking BCL-family inhibition to transcriptional activation of pro-apoptotic BCL2 family members.

changes: Removed BID from proximal_up and late_up: BID is constitutively expressed and activated by caspase-8 cleavage, not by BCL-inhibitor-induced transcription.
Removed BID from late_up to avoid duplication with proximal_up and because its direction is not justified.
Kept BAX, PMAIP1, GADD45A, TRIB3, JUN, FOS, EGR1, NFKBIA, SQSTM1, BNIP3L as up: these are p53/ATF4/AP-1/NF-kB stress-apoptosis genes consistent with BCL inhibition.
Kept BCL2, CCND1, MYC down: BCL2 is the direct target; MYC and CCND1 are suppressed during apoptosis/G1 arrest.
Kept late_down proliferation genes (PCNA, MCM3, TOP2A, AURKA, AURKB, BIRC5, CDK1, CCNB1, CCNA2, E2F2) as downstream consequences of apoptosis and cell-cycle arrest.
Kept kinetics slow and magnitude weak at 6 h, moderate at 24 h: transcriptional apoptosis responses require caspase activation and are delayed.
Kept line_response moderate for most lines and weak for HA1E and HEPG2: HA1E is immortalised normal-like and HEPG2 has altered apoptosis/TP53 status, reducing BCL-inhibitor sensitivity.
Kept evidence PMID 31012964: abstract supports BCL-inhibitor BIM as a downstream effector of TAp63-mediated apoptosis.
